rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone does an activity as an amateur rather than as a job.

example.english: I play guitar as a nonprofessional in my spare time.
example.traditional: 我平時業餘玩結他，唔係靠呢樣搵食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 jip6 jyu4 waan2 git6 taa1 m4 hai6 kaau3 ne1 joeng2 wan2 sik6

rows.jyutping: m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this colloquial attributive pattern when contrasting a person, service, or product with a professional one.

example.english: I hired nonprofessional photographers to help take our wedding photos.
example.traditional: 我搵咗隊唔係專業嘅攝影師幫手影婚紗相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 zo2 deoi6 m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 ge3 sip3 jing2 si1 bong1 sau2 jing2 fan1 saa1 soeng2

rows.note: Use this more formal or written equivalent for something that is not professional without specifically implying it is a hobby.

example.english: This report is only a nonprofessional opinion and cannot replace a formal assessment.
example.traditional: 呢份報告只屬非專業意見，唔可以代替正式評估。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 suk6 fei1 zyun1 jip6 ji3 gin3 m4 ho2 ji5 doi6 tai3 zing3 sik1 ping4 gu2
